# Follow the Springs

*The dying springs lead west and down. Go to the Red Ravine, look closely at three of the roots that run into the rock, and hunt 100 Stone Hulks.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) |
| Level | 62 |
| After | [The Old Walls](../quests/brakka_the_old_walls.md) |
| Leads to | [The Rootdrinker](../quests/ennek_the_rootdrinker.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach [The Red Ravine](../maps/red_ravine.md)
2. Look at a root as thick as a pillar in [The Red Ravine](../maps/red_ravine.md)
3. Look at a root split into the rock in [The Red Ravine](../maps/red_ravine.md)
4. Look at the deepest root in [The Red Ravine](../maps/red_ravine.md)
5. Defeat 100 [Stone Hulk](../monsters/stone_hulk.md)

## Rewards

- 181,000 EXP
- 1,240 mesos
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x10
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md)
